headline: Judge DEFENDS AKADEMIKS - Says he’d be FURIOUS if Akademiks used his interview
body: Judge defends Akademiks in the FBG Duck murder trial, stating he’d be furious if the group used his interview footage. The judge emphasized it’s up to the jury to decide if Ak knew Durk killed Pab. The post, from Trap Lore Ross’s Instagram, highlights the ongoing legal drama with 2,538 likes and 292 comments.
